entries.basis: Three independent firsthand flight reports of actual Boeing 737-800 NG airframes, not MAX 8s or simulators. These describe Delta economy (2016), Delta first (2024) and retrofitted United Next first (2024). Cabin verdicts are operator/configuration/period specific, not evidence of the 1997 prototype cabin or universal airframe comfort; numeric rubric axes remain unchanged.

reviews.title: Review: Delta 737-800 Economy — Las Vegas to New York (JFK)
reviews.quote: The seat itself was surprisingly spacious

reviews.title: Review: Delta First Class Boeing 737-800 (ATL-MEX)
reviews.quote: Despite the seats being thick, they’re not actually terribly comfortable.
